LESSON: CARE OF THE TEETH

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Health Practices
Topic 1.2: Care of the teeth

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Care of the teeth. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. observe hygienic practices stories about shedding milk teeth during shedding of milk teeth, during childhood

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: CARE OF THE TEETH
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES · Grade: Grade 1
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Care of the teeth helps you succeed in HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

KEY FACTS: CARE OF THE TEETH
Study Care of the teeth like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Observe hygienic practices stories about shedding milk teeth during shedding of milk teeth, during childhood

What this means
In this part you learn to observe hygienic practices stories about shedding milk teeth during shedding of milk teeth, during childhood. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: observe hygienic practices stories about shedding milk teeth during shedding of milk teeth, during childhood.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Observe: Name what you can see/touch about “Care of the teeth” around your school.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can observe hygienic practices stories about shedding milk teeth during shedding of milk teeth, during childhood. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Care of the teeth is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name what you can see/touch about “Care of the teeth” around your school. (skill: observe hygienic practices stories about shedding milk teeth during shedding of milk teeth, during childhood)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Care of the teeth to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: observe hygienic practices stories about shedding milk teeth during shedding of milk teeth, during childhood.
3. Make one local Kenya example of Care of the teeth from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Care of the teeth: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 1 learner study Care of the teeth?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Care of the teeth means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: observe hygienic practices stories about shedding milk teeth during shedding of milk teeth, during childhood.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
